observationTiming.description: Optional capability emitted only when both the installed SDK and this exact prepared driver support the timing contract. Absence preserves legacy observations.

UxEvent.title: ALMS manual UX event contract — required durable collection
UxEvent.description: DEC-29: required manual behavior events, stored durably by Backend with server-issued analytics identity and an optional PostHog Cloud EU delivery outbox. Only the allowlisted page/category/button/duration/normalized-error properties are accepted. No school content, credentials, URLs, IP, replay, automatic DOM capture or person profiles.

ui_version.description: Public release label only; no user, school, token, URL or arbitrary content.

randomUuid.description: Independently random analytics-only UUID v4. No school/student/user IDs, hashes, cookies or tokens. Shape checks cannot prove independent generation.

minuteTime.description: UTC rounded down to one minute; no school deadline.

buttonProperties.description: A school source button records only verified target vs normal mypage fallback, without any URL. A fallback is not an error.

durationProperties.description: UI response latency from explicit start to UI shown, failure shown, or abandonment; control_job ends when job acceptance is displayed, never at school playback/submission/attendance completion. Use a monotonic clock; discard hidden-tab/over-5-minute samples. New-tab school page load time is not observed and open_school_link is excluded.

errorProperties.description: Normalized code only. source_missing is a real failure to offer both a target and fallback destination, not the expected nullable sourceUrl/mypage fallback case. No raw message, stack, headers, URL or response.

ui_version.description: Public release label only; no user, school, token, URL or arbitrary content.

client_id.description: Server-owned registered frontend identifier from the authenticated ALMS session. Never accepted in an event body.

posthogEnvelope.description: Logical PostHog event projection. Backend validates and stores the allowlisted event before acknowledgement. Transport adds only the configured project token and a stable server-generated event UUID for retries. URL/referrer/IP/browser/person/header/raw-exception/GeoIP auto-properties are excluded. Cloud receipt requires separate operational verification.

cookieSession.name: __Host-alms_session
cookieSession.description: Default HttpOnly Secure SameSite=Lax cookie. Registered nondefault cookie clients use __Host-alms_session_{clientId}; development HTTP uses alms_session_dev[_clientId]. Select with client header or unique registered Origin. Different-site frontends use PKCE bearer.

bearerSession.description: Client-bound opaque token from /v1/auth/token; exact registered Origin and client header required.

x-alms-query-policy: Strictly validated query objects reject extra, duplicate, or unsupported values where stated. Path/body identity never authenticates an owner.
x-alms-head-policy: HEAD is automatically registered for each GET and returns no body.
x-alms-cors-policy: OPTIONS wildcard is CORS transport infrastructure, not a data operation. Only exact registered/allowed origins receive credentialed CORS.
